# LinkUp

> LinkUp ("Talk. Stream. Meet. Belong.") is a global mobile social app for iOS and Android combining live voice rooms, interactive gift rooms, solo and group live video streaming, international and local 18+ dating, language learning & exchange in 19 languages with real-time AI translation and live captions, Moments & vertical Shorts, LINK relationships, and Host Fanclubs.

- Website: https://linkupmobile.xyz
- Support: support@linkupmobile.xyz
- Platforms: iOS (Apple App Store), Android (Google Play & Direct Android APK)
- Android Package: com.linkup.linkup
- Pricing: Free to download and use; optional VIP ($9.99/mo) and VIP-X ($20/mo, $200/yr, or $500 lifetime)

## Core Features

### 1. Live Voice Rooms & Gift Rooms
- Host or join real-time audio voice rooms with 2 host/co-host seats and 8 guest speaker seats (10 stage seats total).
- Topics include Language Exchange, Music, Gaming, Education, Culture, Casual Chat, Reading Plan, Debate, Storytelling, and Trivia.
- Interactive gifting with virtual gifts, Goodie Bags, Gift Passes, Treasure Chests, room boosts, animated entrance effects, and room levels.
- Built-in AI live captions translate spoken conversation in real time inside rooms.
- Creators and hosts earn Diamonds on gifts received, with payouts via Stripe Connect (for verified 18+ VIP creators).

### 2. Live Video Streaming (Solo & Group Live)
- Go live with full-screen solo video streams or group live streams with guest video tiles.
- Real-time chat, live gifting, viewer lists, and Host Fanclubs.

### 3. International & Local Dating (Connect & Matchmaking)
- Meet language partners, friends, and romantic matches locally (Nearby / City) or internationally across cultures.
- 18+ age-verified dating section powered by Veriff identity verification.
- Rich profiles featuring native and learning languages (1–5 fluency scale), MBTI, zodiac sign, blood type, occupation, hobbies, places visited, and relationship goals (Friendship, Casual, Long-term, Marriage).
- Location and gender filters, Profile Boosts, and VIP-X advanced matchmaking.

### 4. Language Learning & Exchange (19 Languages + AI Translation)
- Supports 19 profile languages: English, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Portuguese, Arabic, Russian, Italian, Hindi, Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish, Indonesian, Dutch, and Swedish.
- Real-time AI chat translation inside Direct Messages, Moment/Short post translation, voice message transcription, and AI live captions in Voice Rooms.

### 5. Moments, Shorts & Messaging
- Share photos, text posts, and full-screen vertical Shorts videos across For You and Following feeds.
- Direct Messages and group chats with AI translation, voice messages, room invites, self-destructing messages (VIP), and Block Unknown Chat protection.

### 6. LINK Relationships & Host Fanclubs
- Official LINK slots: Couple (1 slot), Bestie (5 slots), and Family (2 slots).
- Unlimited daily LINK EXP earned together in Voice/Live rooms (1 base EXP per 10 minutes) and by gifting (1 base EXP per 10 tokens), leveling from Level 0 to Level 6 (0 to 200,000 XP) with Avatar Effects, Chat Bubbles, Entry Effects, Special Gifts, and up to 1.75x EXP boosts.
- Host Fanclubs (unlocking at Room Level 5) with monthly/yearly membership, 5 Fan Levels (0 to 30,000 XP), fan XP tasks, fan comment bubbles, exclusive gift rewards, and exclusive fan badges.

## Safety & Legal
- 18+ community with Veriff age verification, One Device One Account policy, Firebase App Check integrity, and evidence-based moderation.
